show.description: Jab behra Rudra apni sunne ki shakti wapas paata hai, tab uske rishte, uska pyaar aur uska vishwas sab uske khilaaf nikalte hain. Uski perfect wife Suhani aur chhote bhai Vivaan milkar use maarne ka plan banate hain. Lekin ek failed murder ke baad, Rudra apne maut ka natak karta hai aur secretly comeback karta hai, apna sab kuchh wapas paane ke liye.
